title: Derived isomorphisms glue on a finite disjoint cover
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category in universe $w$ with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in universe $w$, let $U\in\mathcal C$, and let $L,N$ belong to the unbounded derived category of sheaves of $R$-modules. Suppose $f_i:Y_i\to U$, indexed by $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, is a finite disjoint covering: its generated sieve covers $U$, each $f_i$ is monic, and for $i\ne j$ every equality $a f_i=b f_j$ with domain $W$ implies that the empty sieve covers $W$. If the exact ringed-slice restrictions [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction] of $L$ and $N$ to each $Y_i$ are isomorphic, then their exact ringed-slice restrictions to $U$ are isomorphic. The derived categories and restriction functors are those recorded in [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. The integer $n$ may be zero.

proof.text: Glue the components of both inverse homotopies using the same sheaf Hom; separatedness verifies the vanishing and homotopy identities. The resulting homotopy equivalence induces a derived isomorphism on U. Conjugate by the representative isomorphisms and the exact-restriction localization comparisons. Empty families are handled by the same sheaf-separatedness arguments.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedDerived_disjoint_iso
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (U : C)
    (L N : ConstantCompletion.D R)
    (n : ℕ) (Y : Fin n → C) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ U)
    (hf : J.IsDisjointCover f)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, Nonempty ((adicResidueRestriction R (Y i)).obj L ≅
      (adicResidueRestriction R (Y i)).obj N)) :
    Nonempty ((adicResidueRestriction R U).obj L ≅
      (adicResidueRestriction R U).obj N)
